shortDescription: Reliance Consumer Products, the consumer arm of Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries NSE:RELIANCE1!, said on Tuesday it will enter the country's ice-cream market with the launch of a new brand, Bombay Creamery.
